home.tagline: A production-grade, configurable website foundation for small businesses
home.description: Provelopment Foundation is an open website foundation for small businesses — a multilingual, configuration-first template that turns JSON, Markdown, and assets into a complete, accessible site. Reuse the proven base instead of starting from scratch.
